label: ADMISSIBLE_PROPOSITION_DOMAIN_1: An explicit subset of World → Prop. allPredicates admits every…
definition: An explicit subset of World → Prop. allPredicates admits every predicate including equality with the root; expressible admits exactly denotations of Formula under a fixed frame and valuation; corpusDomain admits only the supplied indexed inventory. The inventory is a caller parameter, not an automatic claim that the corpus is complete. Negation closure, when explicitly required, means D P implies D (fun w => ¬ P w); it is not built into Domain.
note: Repository-native mathematical fixture requested in #261. No historical attribution or metaphysical endorsement; source-based adoption requires a separate witnessed reading.
